t: This is Nelson's Ship in a Bottle, a sculpture by the British-Nigerian artist Yinka Shonibare. The Greater London Authority commissioned it in 2009, and it first stood on the Fourth Plinth in Trafalgar Square in 2010. Shonibare's work explores cultural identity, colonialism and post-colonialism, and he is known for the brightly coloured Ankara, or batik, fabric he uses. He is paralysed on one side of his body, so he makes his works with assistants working under his direction.
